title: Qosh Tepa canal head, northern Afghanistan
headline: Open water grew 4 % between 17 Jun and 27 Oct

sections.p: Open water grew from 366.4 km² on 17 Jun to 380.4 km² on 27 Oct 2026 (+4 %). Biggest: 380.4 km² on 27 Oct; smallest: 358.5 km² on 28 Aug.
More open water here means the canal and its new fields are taking more water from the Amu Darya, upstream of Uzbekistan.

If the season's trend holds (+1.0 km² a month), the next 3 months would end near 383.4 km². This is a trend line, not a tested forecast: one season of NISAR is too short to learn this place's yearly cycle.
Uzbekistan's and turkmenistan's share of the amu darya. NISAR sees this water every 12 days through cloud and at night.
